extracted.name: Rebecca's Rockin' Vodka Lemonade
extracted.description: Enjoy your summer with a raspberry lemonade-vodka refresher in pink.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen raspberry lemonade concentrate
instruction_lines: In a gallon pitcher prepare the lemonade concentrate according to package instructions, replacing one can of water with the vodka. Squeeze juice from one lime into mixture. Pour over ice and serve.
